title: Arctangent
subtitle: Trigonometric · Inverse
summary: Inverse tangent. Range (−π/2, π/2), domain all reals.
detail:
\[ \arctan x = \int_0^x \frac{dt}{1+t^2} \]

Derivative: \(1/(1+x^2)\). The two-argument form \(\text{atan2}(y,x)\) returns angles in \((-\pi,\pi]\) using the signs of both arguments to determine the correct quadrant. Series: \(\arctan x=x-x^3/3+x^5/5-\cdots\) for \(|x|\le 1\).
